tricks.trick: e⁻ minus, p⁺ plus: Electron Negative, Proton Positive — EN-PP याद रखो; mass में proton heavy, electron light.
T for Thomson, T for तरबूज — बीज = electrons, लाल भाग = + charge.
12-0-0-0: बारह हजार में एक लौटा — R for Rebound rare, Rest go Straight.

tricks.trick: Rutherford = Right nucleus, Wrong lasting orbits — RN-WLO.
Bohr = Bound orbits, No radiation — BONR: Bound + Only certain orbits + No Radiation.
n for Neutral in Nucleus — Chadwick '32: Charge zero, mass like p⁺.
2-8-18-32: 'दो आठ, अठारह, बत्तीस' — और बाहर हमेशा max Eight (octet rule seed).
Octet race: Lose if 1–3, Gain if 5–7 (valency = 8 − valence e⁻), Share often for carbon (4).
